Arrowhead Villas (avmsc.com) covers road maintenance, snow plowing, trash collection and water services. (Charged quarterly $280- works out to a total of around $93/mo) They are a mutual service company NOT an HOA.

results.remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully updated Palisades retreat, ideally situated in one of Lake Arrowhead's most sought-after neighborhoods and just moments from the lake. Offering generous level parking, minimal steps to the front door, and a main-level bedroom with an adjacent bathroom, this inviting four-bedroom home combines mountain charm, modern comfort, and easy year-round living.

Filled with natural light, the main level features a spacious living and dining area, an updated kitchen, a convenient laundry room, and a striking rock fireplace with gas logs that creates a warm and welcoming centerpiece. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a cozy office nook. 

One of the home's standout features is the spacious, extended rear deck, thoughtfully enlarged to create an inviting outdoor living space surrounded by the beauty of the mountains. Framed by lush privacy hedges and a beautiful mature apple tree, the deck feels tucked away and peaceful - an idyllic setting for sipping morning coffee, unwinding with a good book, entertaining friends, or simply enjoying the fresh mountain air. 

The location is equally special, close to Emerald Bay and the marina for convenient boat launching, and approximately seven minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village, where you can enjoy shopping, dining, entertainment, and lakeside activities. 

With its coveted Palisades location, main-level bedroom, level parking, easy entry, beautifully updated interior, expanded outdoor living space,  and exceptional proximity to the lake and village, this turnkey mountain retreat offers an effortless way to enjoy the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle you've been dreaming of.

results.remarks:
Bold, modern, and unforgettable, 476 Annandale is a striking architectural masterpiece known locally as a "Flying W" - this iconic mid-century design is distinguished by its dramatic multi-gabled roofline, soaring vaulted ceilings, and walls of glass that create the feeling of living among the trees.
The upper level showcases an awe-inspiring living space defined by four soaring vaulted gables and spectacular walls of windows that flood the home with natural light while framing the surrounding woodland. An open-concept kitchen and living area create the perfect setting for entertaining or quiet evenings immersed in nature. A full bathroom and two expansive decks extend the living space outdoors, offering multiple places to relax and take in the peaceful forest views.
A sculptural spiral staircase leads to the lower level, where you'll find three comfortable bedrooms, a second full bathroom, a laundry area, and an inviting patio tucked beneath the trees.
Modern conveniences include a mini-split air conditioning system, while coveted lake rights provide access to the beauty the lake has to offer. The property also boasts a proven history as a successful short-term rental, making it an exceptional opportunity for those seeking either a distinctive personal retreat or an income-producing investment.
Architecturally daring, visually impressive, and unlike anything else on the market, 476 Annandale is more than a home - it's a design statement, a peaceful mountain escape, and a rare opportunity to own one of the area's most memorable residences. Furnishings negotiable.

results.remarks: Wake up to some of the most spectacular views in Lake Arrowhead! Overlooking the Lake Arrowhead Country Club golf course, Grass Valley Lake, and surrounded by beautiful ridgelines and towering pines, this move in ready mountain retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and scenery. With level entry, a desirable main level primary suite, and coveted Lake Rights, this home checks all the boxes. Beautifully maintained and tastefully furnished, it's ready to enjoy from day one. The main level welcomes you with soaring vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and a stunning rock fireplace that creates a warm mountain ambiance. The updated kitchen features granite countertops, a breakfast nook, quality appliances, and picturesque views overlooking the golf course and surrounding treetops. The spacious primary suite is conveniently located on the main level and features a walk in closet and private access to the expansive Trex deck, where you'll enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the golf course, Grass Valley Lake, and expansive treetop views. Downstairs offers a generous second living area with another beautiful rock fireplace, two spacious guest bedrooms, a full bathroom, and access to the lower deck. Behind the family room, you'll find a large bonus storage space with endless possibilities. Keep it as exceptional storage, create a workshop, or finish it into additional living space. Down from the deck is a large fenced backyard. Additional features include central air conditioning, a whole house generator for year round peace of mind, and furnishings included, making this an exceptional full time residence, vacation home, or investment opportunity. Rarely do homes combine level entry, a main level primary suite, incredible golf course and lake views, thoughtful updates, and Lake Rights in one complete package. This is mountain living at its best.

results.remarks: Connect with nature in this level-entry, move-in-ready, fully furnished mountain retreat with a touch of Mountain BOHO. This inviting Lake Arrowhead home blends rustic charm, relaxed style, and thoughtful upgrades. From the moment you step inside, you'll feel right at home. The warm, welcoming atmosphere invites you to settle in and enjoy the relaxed mountain lifestyle. Vaulted cathedral ceilings create an airy sense of space, while a beautiful fireplace framed by custom bookcases serves as the heart of the living area. **Remote-controlled ceiling fans in every bedroom and air conditioning provide year-round comfort.** Offering level parking, fully furnished interiors, a whole-house water filtration system, and approximately 1,881 square feet of living space, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features two fireplaces. Just off the dining area, a spacious deck extends your living space outdoors—perfect for morning coffee, gathering with family and friends, or simply taking in the peaceful mountain setting. Large windows showcase tranquil views of the surrounding trees, mountains, and distant desert, bringing nature indoors throughout every season. Adventure is always close by with **LAKE PRIVILEGES!** Enjoy nearby Lake Arrowhead for boating, fishing, and lakeside recreation, or spend the day at the nearby golf course and country club. Hiking trails, off-road adventures, and local ski resorts are all within easy reach, making every season an opportunity to explore. Additional highlights include boat parking, an attached garage, and generous guest parking. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, a weekend getaway, a vacation home, or an investment opportunity, this one-of-a-kind mountain escape offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and the relaxed spirit of Lake Arrowhead living. Ideal for buyers seeking a serene, stylish, nature-inspired lifestyle with excellent potential as an income-producing mountain property.

results.remarks:
An A-frame done right doesn't need much introduction—and this one, tucked into towering pines,
barely waits for you to get out of the car. Level entry, plenty of parking, and a polished exterior that
stands out against the forest: the easy stuff is handled before you're even inside.

Then the ceiling takes over. Soaring wood beams, big windows, and a stone fireplace anchor the living
space, where the light does most of the decorating—bouncing off warm wood tones and framing the
green outside like it was planned.

The dining area flows straight into a beautiful kitchen with smooth-top counters and wood accents.
The deck invites you to greenery amidst fresh pine air—good for company, better for coffee alone.

Climb up to the small loft and you get a bonus sleeping spot plus the best seat in the house for admiring
the A-frame's symmetry. The bedrooms sit cozy, but laid out so nobody feels cramped.

Charming and contemporary. Brilliantly built with a one-of-a-kind atmosphere for your tour.

Set beneath a canopy of towering pines on one of Lake Arrowhead’s most coveted streets, this timeless retreat captures the essence of authentic mountain living. Backing directly to the National Forest, the property offers a rare sense of privacy and connection to nature—where deer wander through your backyard, birdsong fills the air, and every season brings a new, ever-changing landscape.

This stunning, move-in ready Thunderbird-style home is ideally situated in one of Lake Arrowhead’s most desirable neighborhoods, just minutes from the shops and restaurants of Blue Jay. Thoughtfully reimagined in 2020, the home blends elevated mountain living with timeless design, featuring walnut-blasted ceilings, hickory wood floors, and curated designer finishes throughout.
Offering level entry into the main living space, the home welcomes you with vaulted ceilings and a striking river rock fireplace as the centerpiece of the living room. A sliding glass door opens to the expansive Trex deck, rebuilt in 2021, creating a private outdoor retreat surrounded by mature trees and exceptional privacy.
The light-filled kitchen and dining area flow seamlessly from the living room and feature a dual-fuel ILVE 5-burner range, forest green cabinetry, crisp white honed marble countertops, and a built-in wine refrigerator.
Also on the main level is a beautifully designed guest bedroom featuring William Morris wallpaper, along with a luxurious full bath complete with marble floors, a Zuma soaking tub, and handcrafted Zellige tile.
Downstairs, a versatile den/game room is flanked by two well-appointed bedrooms and an additional full bathroom, offering flexible space for guests, entertaining, or relaxing weekends in the mountains.
Recent upgrades include a brand-new whole house generator, upgraded electrical panel, electric vehicle charger, tankless water heater, and brand-new LG washer and dryer. Additional improvements include updated furnace and air conditioning systems, making this home truly turnkey for full-time living or weekend escapes alike.
Complete with coveted lake rights, this sophisticated mountain retreat offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and year-round enjoyment. Select furnishings may be available separately.

results.remarks: Just steps from Grass Valley Lake, this classic Thunderbird is a standout example of one of Lake Arrowhead's most beloved architectural styles. Soaring ceilings, exposed beams, knotty pine, a dramatic wall of glass, and a striking antler chandelier create an unforgettable first impression. Natural light pours into the living spaces, highlighting the home's architectural character and connection to its surroundings. The main living area centers around a beautiful fireplace, offering a warm and inviting space to gather after a day on the lake, the golf course, or nearby trails. Rich wood accents and timeless mountain details evoke the feeling of a private lodge, while the thoughtful floor plan offers comfort and flexibility for everyday living or weekend escapes. The kitchen and dining area are well positioned for both casual meals and entertaining, creating a natural flow between the home's gathering spaces. A bedroom and full bath on the main level add convenience and flexibility, while downstairs, two additional bedrooms, a second full bath, and a secondary living area create an ideal setup for guests, extended family, or multi-generational living. Outside, two spacious decks extend the living space outdoors, offering front row seats to crisp mountain mornings, golden hour sunsets, and star filled evenings. Below, a seasonal creek winds through the property, adding a peaceful natural element and the soothing sound of running water during the wetter months. Whether you're gathered around the fire on a snowy winter evening, enjoying the fresh mountain air from the deck, or spending the day on the lake with family and friends, this Thunderbird offers the kind of authentic mountain experience that never goes out of style.

results.remarks: Glance back to a simpler time with an uncommon sense of privacy in the Arrowhead Villas! Situated on 3 combined lots, there is a generous amount of usable yard space & distance between homes! A vintage, yet bright, lodge style charm with original wood paneling, vaulted beamed ceilings, floor to ceiling rock fireplace with a custom live edge mantel & powerful insert, Wedgewood range in excellent condition, providing for a rich in character mountain retreat. Enter from the lower courtyard into main level large entry, step into the spacious living room hosting picture window views into the forest. Also on this level is the kitchen, dining area, & the shaded back deck. Adjacent to the kitchen is a pantry/storage with access to unfinished workshop (which also has an exterior entrance). Upstairs are 3 bedrooms - a huge bedroom with access to the shared full bath. This level is also accessible from the upper courtyard. There is approximately 3-4 car parking between the fairly new parking deck & a parallel parking space on the street. There are 2 lovely courtyard areas with plenty of room to entertain & relax in the cool of the surrounding cedars, oaks, & dogwoods. The backyard is beautifully landscaped and very lush. There are various peeks of the lake from the property. And... Furniture included! Exterior Paint, upgraded electrical and new parking deck with in the past 3 years. Roof is a 40 year roof installed in 2006.  Arrowhead Villas Mutual Services Company is a mutual utility company providing trash & snow removal, road repairs/maintenance, & 200 gallons/day water usage - Annual dues are appx $1200.

GREAT future Income or extended family living space. No Cookie Cutter home here totally one of a kind.

results.remarks: Recent price reduction! In the highly desirable Palisades neighborhood on storied John Muir Road, this First Tier retreat is upgraded in every detail and sits on a lake front street with lake rights and coveted peeks of the water, a rare blend of legacy location and effortless walkability. Adding to the rarity: a two-car garage plus generous driveway parking (room for multiple vehicles), giving you the convenience that is desired in Lake Arrowhead. Step through the charming Dutch door into soaring ceilings, rich wood beams, and a massive stone fireplace that instantly sets a mountain tone. The main level is an open-concept living room, breakfast nook, and kitchen connect seamlessly, wrapped in windows that pull in forest views. The primary suite on the main floor feels like a private sanctuary with multiple closets and a spa-inspired bath featuring a dual vanity and deep soaking tub, plus its own private deck—perfect for quiet mornings in the trees. Upstairs, two more bedrooms, one with double bunks—ideal for hosting family and friends. With three bathrooms, ceiling fans in every bedroom, and an upstairs interior laundry room with newer washer/dryer, the home is designed to be as comfortable as it is memorable. The recently renovated wraparound deck is surrounded by mature trees, ideal setting for starry-night dinners, coffee, or après-snow gatherings. Thoughtful details—automatic sensor lighting for safe evening strolls, a gas line to the grill, and a dedicated custom made bear box at the end of the driveway. The kitchen is a standout: designer finishes, soft-close cabinetry, custom lighting and chandeliers, and a Wedgewood retro gas stove, paired with stainless appliances and every amenity you want for weekends (and extended stays). Offered fully furnished, this home delivers a true “arrive-and-enjoy” experience—high-end décor and furnishings down to the details, an 8-person dining table, oversized sectional, flat-screen TVs, shuffleboard, lake toys, and even a built-in air compressor/automatic pump for inflatables and tires. There is a newer central A/C with Nest controls, tankless water heater, wood-trim windows, a large basement storage area sized for all the lake toys. Whether you’re looking for a soulful lake escape, a full-time luxury retreat, or a proven investment with strong short-term rental appeal, this is the kind of Lake Arrowhead opportunity that rarely comes along.

Mountain Retreat with full deeded Lake rights  And Golf Course Convenience. 

Discover a spacious mountain home offering  1,700 square feet of flexible living space across three inviting levels. Surrounded by natural rock landscaping. This distinctive property combines mountain character, indoor-outdoor living, and sought-after access to the lake and golf course.

Whether you are seeking a full-time mountain residence, a peaceful second home, or a getaway for family and friends, this three-level retreat offers space, warmth, and the mountain-lake lifestyle buyers are looking for.

results.remarks: Design forward, extensively updated and set against one of Lake Arrowhead’s most compelling ridgeline views, The Tollhouse is a modern mountain classic, beautifully reimagined without losing its original character. With lake rights, level parking for three vehicles and two expansive decks, this three story retreat is made for effortless mountain living. Soaring wood clad ceilings, exposed beams and a dramatic wall of glass define the main living space, while an impressive stone fireplace brings warmth and mountain character. The completely remodeled kitchen features soft white cabinetry, stone countertops, floating wood shelving and warm gold details. results.remarks:
Perched against the backdrop of the National Forest, this one-of-a-kind mountain retreat offers an unforgettable blend of breathtaking scenery, thoughtful updates, and eclectic design. Enjoy sweeping views of the Pinnacles, the high desert, Mt. Baldy, and spectacular sunset skies, all from the comfort of your own mountain sanctuary.
The main level is designed for effortless living, featuring a dramatic living room anchored by a stunning floor-to-ceiling rock fireplace and wrapped in walls of windows that blur the line between indoors and out. Surrounded by towering trees and natural beauty, you'll feel immersed in the forest from nearly every angle. Wide-plank oak flooring flows throughout the home, while the beautifully updated kitchen and bathrooms offer a fresh, modern touch.
Also on the main level are two comfortable bedrooms, a full bathroom, and access to the rear deck - an ideal setting for entertaining, or simply soaking in the peaceful surroundings.
Upstairs, a spacious loft serves as a playful third bedroom or flexible retreat. The lower level offers exceptional versatility with a generous family room featuring a second fireplace that easily doubles as a fourth sleeping area, along with an additional full bathroom - perfect for hosting family and guests.
Brimming with personality, the home's thoughtfully curated interiors feature bold designer wallpaper and unique finishes that create a memorable, inviting atmosphere. Offered furnished per the seller's inventory, it's ready to be enjoyed as a full-time residence, weekend escape, or successful vacation rental.
Additional highlights include level parking and near-level entry, low-maintenance vinyl siding, a durable metal roof, air conditioning for year-round comfort, coveted Lake Rights, location on a quiet cul-de-sac and direct access to miles of National Forest just beyond your backyard. Whether you're watching the sun set over the distant mountains, exploring nearby trails, or relaxing fireside after a day on the lake or slopes, this exceptional property captures the very best of mountain living.

results.remarks: This beautifully designed Prow-style cabin sits nestled among the trees and captures the essence of mountain living, featuring lake rights and a glimmering peek-a-boo view of the water. Enjoy soaring knotty pine cathedral ceilings, a dramatic wall of glass, and a floor-to-ceiling rock fireplace, creating a warm, light-filled atmosphere that feels both classic and inviting. The main level offers an easy, comfortable flow with the primary bedroom, full bath, kitchen, dining area, and access to the deck, all on one floor. The open kitchen features a breakfast bar, dining space, and brand-new modern appliances, making it ideal for everyday living, weekend gatherings, or hosting guests. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and a full bath provide plenty of room for family and friends, while the lower level adds even more flexibility with a bedroom, full bath, laundry area, kitchenette, and spacious bonus family room that can function beautifully as a game room, media space, guest retreat, or 4th bedroom setup. Multiple decks invite you to slow down and enjoy the peaceful setting, whether you are sipping coffee beneath the trees, entertaining after a day on the lake, or simply relaxing in the mountain air. The location adds even more appeal with private lake access, nearby snow play, hiking and mountain biking trails, and the ability to stroll to Blue Jay Bay or continue on to the restaurants and charm of Blue Jay Village. With level parking and easy access from the city, beach, or desert, an STR permit already in place, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy everything from day one. Whether you are looking for a personal escape, a full-time mountain home, or a rental-ready retreat, this cabin delivers space, scenery, charm, and income potential in one unforgettable package.  Make sure you put this one at the top of your list!

Welcome to Timberline Artisan Lodge, a beautifully remodeled mountain retreat where timeless cabin charm meets elevated design and craftsmanship. Thoughtfully redesigned by locally renowned builder John Radleigh, known for his exceptional wood craftsmanship, this home showcases custom details and authentic materials that truly set it apart.

The exterior features hand-selected local logs, carefully crafted to create the feel of a true log cabin while maintaining a refined and cohesive aesthetic. Every detail reflects Radleigh’s signature style—blending rustic authenticity with modern livability.

Step inside to discover a light-filled interior with vaulted ceilings, rich wood accents, and an open, airy feel throughout. The stunning A-frame living space showcases dramatic picture windows that frame the surrounding forest, creating a breathtaking focal point and bringing the outdoors in. Exposed beams, warm wood tones, and curated finishes create a cozy yet elevated mountain atmosphere.

The home offers multiple comfortable sleeping areas, including spacious bedrooms and a charming bunk room, perfect for hosting family and guests. The primary suite serves as a private retreat with its own sitting area, fireplace, and peaceful treetop views—offering both comfort and privacy.

The kitchen and living areas flow seamlessly, ideal for entertaining or relaxing after a day in the mountains. Bathrooms feature updated fixtures and a fresh, neutral palette, while thoughtful design elements throughout enhance both style and functionality.

Additional features include a dedicated laundry area, ample storage, and well-appointed spaces designed for everyday ease. Whether you're seeking a full-time residence, weekend escape, or income-producing property, this home offers exceptional versatility.

Surrounded by nature yet conveniently located, Timberline Artisan Lodge captures the essence of mountain living—peaceful, scenic, and effortlessly inviting. Enjoy morning coffee on the deck, cozy evenings by the fire, and year-round enjoyment in a setting that feels like a true retreat.

A rare opportunity to own a turnkey mountain home with distinctive craftsmanship, authentic materials, and timeless appeal.

results.remarks:
The Arrowhead Trail House With Potential Half a Double Dock Available. Beautifully reimagined and fully renovated mountain retreat with Lake Rights, ideally located along the coveted ALA trail with direct access to Lake Arrowhead. This stunning home offers the rare convenience of reaching the lake in under two minutes via a private bridge connecting the property to the lake trail, creating an effortless lake lifestyle.

Inside, the home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 beautifully renovated bathrooms, thoughtfully redesigned with modern finishes and timeless mountain style. Nearly every element of the home has been updated, blending clean contemporary design with warm natural textures to create a welcoming and comfortable retreat.

The main living spaces feature wide-plank flooring, custom millwork, and abundant natural light, while the remodeled kitchen offers stylish cabinetry, stone countertops, and stainless appliances—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.

Downstairs, a dedicated game and entertainment room provides the ultimate gathering space, complete with a pool table and game table, making it ideal for hosting friends and family after a day on the lake or the slopes.

Outdoor living is equally impressive with two large entertaining decks surrounded by mature trees. The lower deck features a private spa and lounge area, creating the perfect place to relax under the stars. From here, a private bridge leads directly to the ALA lake trail, giving you easy access to the shoreline and nearby lakefront.

Additional upgrades include air conditioning for year-round comfort, a rare and desirable feature in mountain homes.

The property also includes full Lake Arrowhead Lake Rights, allowing owners to enjoy the private lake, beaches, and recreational amenities. For boating enthusiasts, a half a double dock located just two minutes away is also available for purchase separately, offering an incredible opportunity to secure immediate lake access.

With its prime trail-side location, extensive renovations, multiple outdoor living spaces, and unbeatable access to the lake, this home offers the perfect balance of luxury, recreation, and mountain tranquility.

Tucked inside the gated community of Meadow Bay North, Meadow Bay Hideaway is a beautifully updated Lake Arrowhead retreat where modern mountain style meets one of the area’s most desirable amenities: a private sandy beach reserved for homeowners and their guests.

Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings, walls of windows, warm wood floors, and an open layout filled with natural light. The living room is centered around a stone fireplace and handsome wood accent wall, creating a cozy gathering space that still feels fresh, bright and contemporary.

The open-concept kitchen and dining area have been thoughtfully updated with crisp white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, farmhouse-style sink, open shelving and statement lighting. Whether you are looking for a weekend escape, a full-time mountain home or an easy lock-and-leave retreat, Meadow Bay Hideaway captures the best of Lake Arrowhead living—gated privacy, beautiful interiors, towering pines and your own private path to the lake.

Welcome to Meadow Bay Hideaway, where mountain mornings begin among the pines and summer afternoons end with your toes in the sand.

results.remarks: Panoramic lake views, exceptional privacy and a detached guest house distinguish this updated 1928 mountain retreat in Crest Estates. Surrounded by forest with no homes directly above or below, the setting feels remarkably private while remaining convenient to Lake Arrowhead Village, lakefront shops and dining. Inside, soaring trestle-beamed ceilings, a floor-to-ceiling rough-hewn granite fireplace and expansive windows give the great room dramatic character while framing sweeping lake and forest views. The remodeled kitchen features custom cabinetry, new appliances and an easy connection to the dining area and outdoor living spaces. Multiple decks extend the experience beneath the trees, while the primary suite opens to a private balcony overlooking the lake. A flexible additional bedroom in the main house and a fully renovated detached studio guest house provide useful separation for visitors, work, hobbies or creative space. Major improvements include a complete replacement septic system, updated electrical panel, tankless water heater and updated heating. Set on more than a third of an acre at the end of the road, this is a distinctive Lake Arrowhead property for buyers who value view, privacy, condition, character and flexible separate space. Property does not include lake rights.

results.remarks:
This charming mountain retreat offers lake rights, privacy, and stunning views—making it an ideal full-time home, getaway, or successful short-term rental. Enjoy level parking for two cars and a welcoming covered porch entry leading into a spacious foyer. The main living area showcases vaulted wood ceilings, rich wood flooring, and a striking rustic stone fireplace—creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The open-concept living and dining spaces are filled with natural light and offer direct access to a gorgeous, expansive deck where you can take in tranquil forest and mountain views, vibrant sunsets, and distant city lights. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a wine fridge, and a charming bay window overlooking the front of the home. A full bathroom on the main level adds convenience. Downstairs, you’ll find three bedrooms and a full bathroom, along with a functional mudroom with laundry. One bedroom includes a bonus room extension, perfect for an office, playroom, or home gym. Additional highlights include an EV charger, newer roof and windows, and great natural light throughout. The adjoining 9,554 sq. ft. lot is also available for purchase, with the buyer having first right of refusal—offering added privacy or future expansion potential.

This home offers the perfect blend of comfort, character, and mountain lifestyle.

results.remarks:
Once imagined as an intimate and casual wedding ceremony enclave is now a sprawling, Lodge-style single-family residence situated on a total of three large lots equaling 1.5 acres. Home is located in Skyforest community (literally a forest in the trees w/mature specimens over 200 yrs old with Ponderosa pines, cedar, maple, Dogwood, oaks & white fir, many over 100ft tall)).Dramatic, illuminated river rock retaining walls wind up the gently sloping driveway, framing lush, manicured landscaping.-----------------------------------------------------------------------

The home features an open and spacious layout with high cathedral ceilings, exposed beams, and wide tongue-and-groove paneling throughout. The split-level entrance leads to a fantastic game room and den featuring a sunken U-shaped bar, an eating area, a bathroom, and a laundry room. The main level living room offers a fireplace and sliding doors that open to a deck with expansive views.-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Back at the foyer and up a few steps, the kitchen and dining area features a large island, leading directly to a super-sized, hotel-style primary ensuite bedroom. This primary suite includes an extra-large Jacuzzi tub set against a picture window looking out into the forest, a private deck, and a separate entrance to the front deck. A floating staircase from the kitchen leads to two additional bedrooms connected by a Jack and Jill vanity and a full bath. Downstairs, you will find a study and bonus room lined with custom bookshelves, a potbelly stove, and direct access to the backyard------------------------------------------

Parking is plentiful, with two carports, space for 3 to 4 additional cars, and several turnout areas on Kuffel Canyon Road directly in front of the adjacent vacant lots.  A mostly level back yard houses a large, two-story shed w/roll-up garage door.  Property is walking distance to the trendy "Kuffel Corner" district with coffee shop, boutique wine store, restaurants (Lou Eddy's famous Pizza), mercantile, vintage clothing, antique stores, hair salon, Heaps Peak Arboretum and more. - - - - - - - - - - - 


Two ½ acre lots immediately adjacent to the home’s parcel add unparalleled privacy and provide for future development are being sold with the home for additional.  Also, 2 minute drive down to Lake Arrowhead Village entrance.

results.remarks:
Welcome to the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle, where forest trails, lake days, mountain views, and an easygoing pace are all part of everyday life. Offered furnished and ready to enjoy, this inviting mountain home makes it easy to arrive, unpack, and start living the mountain life from day one.

Inside, the home feels comfortable, bright, and made for gathering. The living spaces invite you to settle in after a day on the lake or trail, curl up by the fireplace on a snowy evening, or simply enjoy the beautiful tree and mountain views that change with the seasons. The kitchen and dining areas flow naturally into the living space, while the outdoor deck extends daily living into the fresh mountain air. Whether it is morning coffee surrounded by pines, dinner outside on a summer evening, or a quiet weekend with nowhere you need to be, this is a home designed to be enjoyed.

The spacious primary suite provides a private retreat of its own, with room for a sitting area, den, or home office, along with a private bath, walk-in closet, fireplace, and beautiful mountain views. Two additional bedrooms provide comfortable space for family and guests, making the home equally well suited for full-time living or weekends filled with friends and family.

And then there is the location. Lake rights open the door to the quintessential Lake Arrowhead experience, while the popular 2N75 Forestry Trail is just down the street for morning hikes, dog walks, forest adventures, and miles of outdoor recreation practically outside your door. Lake Arrowhead Elementary is less than half a mile away, and Tavern Bay Beach Club is about a mile from home for swimming, picnics, and summer days at the lake. Nearby MacKay Park adds pickleball, a dog park, playground, gathering spaces, and even more ways to enjoy the outdoors.

With beautiful mountain scenery, lake rights, exceptional access to the forest, and furnishings already in place, this is more than a mountain house waiting for its next owner. It is an opportunity to step into the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle without waiting to make it feel like home.

Welcome to 788 Crown Dr, a fully remodeled, turnkey mountain retreat in the heart of Lake Arrowhead offering lake rights, comfort, and versatility.
This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home sits on a spacious 10,800 sq ft corner lot and has been thoughtfully upgraded to combine modern finishes with classic mountain charm. Inside offers vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light create an open, inviting feel, while the main living area features a cozy fireplace and seamless flow into the kitchen and dining space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. This home is being offered fully furnished and equipped, making it move-in ready for a full-time residence or second home. Central A/C throughout which is rare for the area adds year-round comfort.

The garage is currently set up as a game room, providing a flexible bonus space perfect for entertaining, a home gym, or additional living area, with the option to easily convert it back to a traditional garage if desired. Adding even more value, the owner has already purchased a jacuzzi and is in the process of having it installed giving the next owner an upgraded outdoor amenity to enjoy upon completion. Currently operating as a short-term rental with management in place, the property also offers optional income potential for those looking to offset ownership costs.

Located in a desirable area of Lake Arrowhead with year-round appeal from snowy winters to sunny lake days this home offers the ideal balance of lifestyle, comfort, and flexibility. Come experience the best of Lake Arrowhead.

results.remarks: Brand New Mountain Retreat with Lake Rights & Customization Potential! Welcome to 26885 Modoc Ln, Lake Arrowhead—a stunning brand new construction listing offering a perfect blend of modern luxury, accessibility, and mountain charm. Currently in its final stages of construction, this 3-bedroom, 1,606-square-foot home presents a rare and exciting opportunity. This brand new construction is waiting for your finishing touch choices to make it your own, allowing the buyer to choose their flooring and select their own countertops to perfectly match their personal style before completion! The upstairs main entry level is thoughtfully designed to be ADA-compliant for wheelchair access, flowing seamlessly into a large open-concept living and dining area anchored by a cozy gas fireplace. The chef's gourmet kitchen features crisp white shaker cabinets, a large stainless steel farm sink, a breakfast bar countertop, and a dedicated desk working area. Premium kitchen touches include Cafe stainless steel dishwasher drawers, a Trifecte five-burner cooktop with a stainless range hood, and LG ThinQ double ovens. Just off the dining area, sliding glass doors open to a sprawling Trex deck showcasing breathtaking, unobstructed mountain views. Enjoy convenient direct entry from the front door to the attached 2-car garage, which includes an automatic opener and additional storage space. Downstairs, the spacious primary suite serves as a relaxing retreat featuring recessed lighting, a large walk-in closet, and private sliding glass doors leading to a lower-level Trex deck. Its en-suite bathroom is plumbed and ready for double sinks, a toilet, a large jetted tub, and a shower-in-tub. Two additional guest bedrooms offer comfortable accommodations with ample closet space and are fully wired for high-speed internet. The downstairs level also includes a guest bathroom with a one-piece prefab tub/shower and a large dedicated laundry room outfitted with gas and water hookups. The home includes modern USB-A and USB-C integrated wall outlets placed throughout for ultimate convenience. It boasts exceptional efficiency with double-insulated walls achieving a superior R-26.20 energy rating, Jeld-Wen WUI (Wildland-Urban Interface) rated windows, and a modern fire suppression system. Complete with 4 additional uncovered parking spaces and highly coveted lake rights granting access to Grass Valley Park and the Lake Arrowhead Country Club, this custom mountain home is ready to welcome you!

results.remarks: A rare opportunity to own a furnished lake-rights home offering beautiful lake views, a coveted dock slip, and a ski boat - a thoughtfully assembled offering designed for effortless enjoyment of the lake. The 3-bed, 3-bath home pairs a beautifully considered layout, abundant natural light, & a seamless connection to the outdoors. A landscaped front garden & distinctive redwood accents create a welcoming first impression, while a 2-car garage, & additional spaces provide ample parking. The garage connects directly to the interior of the home, offering the convenience of coming & going without stepping outside. Adjacent to the garage, a separate bonus space with its own exterior entrance is well suited to a creative studio, gym, workshop, or storage.The main level is bright & inviting, with a spacious living room, well-appointed kitchen, & separate dining area arranged for both everyday living and entertaining. A powder room & laundry add to the functionality of the floor. Large windows draw in natural light, while the living spaces open directly onto the outdoor decks. The first deck extends the dining and entertaining areas outdoors. A second deck leads to the home's most compelling vantage point, where the lake views take center stage. The fully fenced yard provides a private & versatile outdoor setting. Upstairs, 3 bedrooms & 2 bathrooms offer a comfortable separation between the home's living & sleeping areas. The primary suite is spacious with 2 closets, a large bathroom & fireplace. Beyond the residence, the lake offering is what sets this property apart. The dock (MBM 13-1) is in a prime location in the deep waters of sought after Meadow Bay. The dock occupies the first slip on the multi-slip dock closest to the party deck, with a uniquely broad footprint, dock box & built in racks for kayaks. A well maintained 2008 Tige 22VE ski boat is also included. Combined with the home's lake rights, the result is a rare opportunity to step into the lake lifestyle with the most important pieces already in place. The sellers have made thoughtful improvements, including a new HVAC system, smart home system, fresh paint, to name a few & the water heater was replaced in 2021. The lake trail is also nearby, as are Tavern Bay and UCLA Tavern. Cedar Glen & the Village are also a short distance from the home, with restaurants, shops, and coffee. A well-appointed home, meaningful lake access, and a turnkey collection of the essentials for life on the water.

results.remarks:
Welcome to one of the most coveted locations in Skyforest — “the Loop.” This fully remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,524 sq. ft. of modern living space across two levels, plus a 350 sq. ft. finished build-up on the lower level.

Situated on an expansive 1.19-acre, street-to-street lot, this property gives you the feeling of owning your own private forest. Every window frames a beautiful view of towering trees, with brilliant seasonal color changes and California mountain dogwoods scattered throughout the property.

Features & Upgrades
Completely remodeled – brand new inside and out
Three oversized bedrooms | 2 bathrooms | 1,524 sq. ft. + 350 sq. ft. finished build-up
Two-story floor plan with spacious, open-concept living
Wrap-around main deck plus two additional decks – perfect for entertaining or enjoying tree-top views
Massive walk-in closets in upstairs bedrooms with brand-new cabinetry and custom clothing storage systems
Extremely rare 3-step entry – easy, convenient access that few mountain homes can match
Expansive paved private parking with space for 10+ vehicles — ideal for boats, smaller RVs, and hosting many guests with ease
Only 2 minutes from Highway 18 for quick, convenient access on or off the mountain via Hwy 18 or 330
Street-to-street lot offering privacy and unique property layout
All major appliances new within the last 3-4 years — refrigerator, chest freezers, water heater, central heater, oven, and microwave
Currently fully furnished – furnishings negotiable
County-maintained and plowed roads – year-round access and peace of mind during winter months
Located in the exclusive Skyforest Loop neighborhood
 
Location & Lifestyle
Just minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village for dining, shopping, and entertainment, and a short drive to Heaps Peak Arboretum for beautiful forest trails and outdoor adventures. This home offers the perfect blend of privacy and accessibility — ideal for full-time living, a weekend retreat, or a lucrative vacation rental.

Why You’ll Love This Home
With over an acre of land, you’re not just buying a home — you’re claiming a private mountain sanctuary. Enjoy forest views from every room, brilliant fall foliage, and blooming mountain dogwoods in the spring. Move in and experience the peace and privacy that few homes on the mountain can offer.

results.remarks: Freshly painted interior & new carpet!  Home is now vacant & ready to go!  Just a quick hop to the lake, UCLA conference center or out hwy 173 for some hiking or off-roading, this home offers the perfect location for all your needs.  Situated just above North Bay, (always plowed first in winter) this well cared for property has plenty of parking, even a 30 foot level pad for RV or a boat & is level entry!  The main level features a spacious living room with a rock fireplace, good size dining area & an updated kitchen with granite counters & stainless appliances. Roomy kitchen with lots of natural light & just adjacent to the laundry room & access to the garage. Once upstairs you will be greeted with vaulted ceilings & lots of natural light. One guest room has a spacious walk-in closet, the other that is being used as an office has a beautiful little alcove surrounded by windows to enjoy the views.  The 3rd is the primary suite with its own little deck, a walk-in closet, a gas fireplace & another full bathroom!  This home has been well maintained & recently had a full exterior paint job including the decks & railings.  There is a fenced dog run behind the house & access into the 2 car insulated garage from that area. Surrounded by lots of beautiful oak trees which will offer lots of shade in the summer but to keep you extra cool this home also has AC!  A great home for all seasons & ready to enjoy!

Situated on an expansive approximately 15,000 sq. ft. lot spanning five parcels, this property offers outstanding privacy surrounded by towering pines, a peaceful greenbelt, and a seasonal stream—creating your own private mountain sanctuary. results.remarks: Prime location near Lake Arrowhead Golf Course, Lake Rights, flat backyard, street-level entry, two-car garage, hardwood flooring, two fireplaces, balconies, high ceilings, oversized loft, and full-time living. Built in 1991, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath mountain home offers three levels of living space and an exceptional opportunity for buyers looking to renovate, update, and create their own Lake Arrowhead retreat. The home is largely original and needs significant updating, but offers desirable features including real oak hardwood flooring, copper plumbing, recessed lighting, two fireplaces, multiple balconies, and a two-car garage. The bright living room features high ceilings and a cozy fireplace, while the main level includes a dining area, spacious kitchen, comfortable den with a second fireplace, bonus room, powder room, and balcony overlooking the expansive, flat backyard. Upstairs, a dramatic oversized loft with pitched ceilings overlooks the living area below. The primary suite features a private balcony, double sinks, soaking tub, and separate shower. The lower level offers three additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, dedicated laundry room, and access to another balcony from two of the bedrooms. Easy street-level entry with no steep access road, direct interior access from the two-car garage, and additional off-street parking add to the home's everyday convenience. Located just a short drive from Lake Arrowhead Village, shopping, dining, recreation, and the lake. With Lake Rights, a generous floor plan, desirable golf course-area location, and plenty of potential, this is an ideal opportunity to update and personalize a mountain home for full-time living or a weekend retreat.

space for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

results.remarks:
Nestled in the historic Arrowhead Villas area of Lake Arrowhead, this 1,789-square-foot, fully furnished and renovated mountain home is the ultimate turnkey family retreat. Designed for peaceful mountain living and multi-generational comfort, the residence features 4 bedrooms and 2.5 baths across three thoughtfully laid out levels, plus a detached, fully remodeled Studio/Loft with a modern bi-fold door—ideal for a private home office, creative space, or guest suite.
Situated across 2 spacious lots, the property boasts grade-level parking for up to 4 vehicles and plenty of room to explore, complete with fresh apples and blackberries growing right on the lot. The main level welcomes you with an inviting living and dining area, a main-floor bedroom, a full bath, and an updated kitchen complete with butcher block countertops and stainless-steel appliances. Upstairs offers two additional cozy bedrooms and a remodeled half bath, while the lower level features a large bedroom, full bath, laundry room, and generous storage.
High-end upgrades and peace of mind flow throughout, including a BRAND-NEW ROOF (June 2026) with a 10-year transferable warranty, a 1300W portable power generator, dual-pane Milgard windows, solid-core doors, a spacious redwood deck, and full smart-home integration (Nest cameras, video doorbell, smart thermostat, and surround sound).
While perfectly suited as a move-in ready personal sanctuary, the home comes fully equipped with optional established management and cleaning services in place if you wish to host short-term guests. Arrowhead Villas features its own mutual water system (approx. $80/month paid quarterly), which covers water, snow removal (one of the first streets plowed), trash, and road maintenance. Located just minutes from the lake, shops, and local dining—don't miss this Lake Arrowhead gem!

results.remarks: Welcome to this magical quintessential fairy tale cottage! Located lakeside in the Palisades area at Orchard Bay and only a short walk to the water’s edge via #10 ALA gate with gentle walking trails to village and beach clubs with full lake rights for your summer fun.  Enjoy Lake Arrowhead Village’s seasonal entertainment, dining, and shopping all within minutes of arrival!  This one of a kind vintage Craftsman (circa 1951) has been updated while maintaining it’s authentic charm and integrity.  The words “Once Upon a Time” come to mind when you visit this historically relevant home once owned by the Waterman family (aka Waterman Cyn. Rd).  Old world cobblestone stairs and a meandering pathway lead you right to front door and your fairytale journey begins! Step inside to a open airy floor plan accented with nostalgic character and careful restoration.  The main level living room has beamed ceilings, Pickford tongue and groove wall paneling, a Craftsman brick fireplace, refinished and original Douglas fir wood flooring, 2 large wood paned windows that over look the huge patio areas front and rear both nodding to the majestic pine, cedar and dog wood trees that abound. A generously sized master suite on main level has board and batten walls, new tile and a new frameless shower door.  The kitchen and dining rooms are updated with new cabinetry, granite, and stainless appliances.  Additionally on main level a guest bedroom that currently functions as an artist studio/laundry area with brand new stackable washer and dryer.  Moving up the winder stairs, a study/den area with built in desk and 3 additional guest bedrooms, one being perfect for a cozy kid get away. Other improvements include dual paned windows, new interior wood treatments, paint inside and out, new floor coverings, curated furnishings professionally appointed, multiple outside areas with new sprinkler system and leaf gutter system. Great vacation retreat, weekend get aways, or investment opportunity for your family generational wealth.  Opportunity knocks at this sought after location offering a taste of classic Lake Arrowhead lifestyles at the lake! THIS HOME IS OFFERED TURNKEY FURNISHED WITH A FEW EXCLUSIONS

Nestled among the pines in the desirable Deer Lodge Park neighborhood of Lake Arrowhead, this well-maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers approximately 1,850 square feet of comfortable living space on an 8,494 square foot lot. 

The open-concept main level is filled with natural light from large windows that bring the outdoors in. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect gathering space during every season. The beautifully remodeled kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with quality finishes, a gas range, modern appliances, and a convenient indoor laundry area, all flowing seamlessly into the dining space for easy everyday living and entertaining.

Both bathrooms have been meticulously remodeled with exceptional attention to detail, offering a clean, timeless design that complements the home's mountain character. All four bedrooms are generously sized, providing comfortable accommodations for family and guests.

Downstairs, you'll find an inviting second living space centered around a charming freestanding wood-burning stove, creating the perfect setting for relaxing after a day on the trails or enjoying the snow. 

Climate control is a breeze with central AC and heat to warm those frosty toes or cool down after a mountain hike! 

Enjoy the peaceful mountain setting from the spacious rear decks located on both levels of the home. Built with low-maintenance Trex-style composite decking, these outdoor living spaces are designed for lasting durability and resistance to moisture, making them ideal for year-round enjoyment.

Conveniently located near the Lake Arrowhead Pinnacles Hiking Trail, the OHV staging area, and just a short drive from Lake Arrowhead Village with its shopping, dining, restaurants, and year-round activities, this home offers easy access to everything the mountain has to offer. An added bonus is the plowed road access during the winter months, providing reliable year-round accessibility when snow arrives.

If you've been searching for a move-in ready mountain home with beautifully remodeled interiors, multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces, and an excellent Lake Arrowhead location, this property is one you won't want to miss.

results.remarks: Welcome to Old Mill, where lake views, privacy, and an unbeatable location come together to create the perfect mountain retreat. Tucked away on the coveted south side of Lake Arrowhead, this charming cabin sits just moments from the water, with stairs from the property leading directly to the lake trail for easy access to lake days, morning walks, and sunset strolls.Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee overlooking the lake, spending summer evenings on the deck enjoying the stunning sunsets, or watching the 4th of July fireworks light up the sky, every season offers something special.Inside, the inviting two bedroom, two bath layout and open floor plan is ideal as a weekend getaway, full-time residence, or income producing vacation rental. An additional parcel, included in the sale, expands the property to just over 11,000 square feet, creating a rare sense of privacy while also offering additional space and potential for future expansion.Beneath the home, a generous storage area provides plenty of room for kayaks, paddleboards, lake toys, and all of your mountain gear, so you're always ready for a day on the water.Located just five minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village, restaurants, coffee shops, and year-round recreation, you'll enjoy the convenience of being close to everything while still feeling tucked away in a peaceful setting. If you're in the mood for a walk, you can even follow the lake trail directly into the Village. With lake views, direct trail access to the water, and a setting that's hard to come by, Old Mill is the perfect place to enjoy everything Lake Arrowhead has to offer.

results.remarks: Charming Palisades Lakefront home with Single Dock (1/2 of double dock) and dock storage.  Stunning Views for every level.  You enter this 3 level home on the top level which is the street level directly from the private parking area which has room for at least 3 cars.  Note the carved bears on both sides of the entry.  Entering on the 3rd level then a few steps down is the door to the large Master Bedroom suite, which has a sitting area, stone faced double sided gas fireplace, then into the spacious master bath.  Views from every window!!  There's a jetted bath tub sitting right below the fireplace, separate shower stall, double sink, Large closet, and private toilet room.  Come out and walk down the stairs to the 2nd level with has the Kitchen, dining, and living room areas.  Kitchen has all Stainless Steel appliances, natural wood cabinets, pantry, tile flooring and fantastic lake and mountain views!  Sit around the dining table and you'll enjoy more beautiful views.  Nice living room with a lovely brick wood burning gas fireplace.  Then walk out to the large patio deck with lots of entertainment area and views galore.  From there you also have access down the patio stairs to the bottom level.  Now from the LR go down the stairs to the bottom level which consist of 2 bedrooms, bath, laundry closet, etc.  The 3rd bedroom has been converted to a den area that has the laundry closet and the doorway out to the bottom level patio deck.  Home can come furnished.

results.remarks: Welcome to the A-frame retreat you've been dreaming of! This fully renovated gem, nestled amidst the trees of Lake Arrowhead, perfectly blends modern updates with timeless mountain charm. Offering a turnkey lifestyle, this home promises effortless living in a prime location. Step inside to be greeted by an inviting open living area, bathed in natural light, thanks to the striking floor-to-ceiling windows that offer breathtaking views of the surrounding forest. Cozy up by the fireplace on chilly nights or venture onto one of the three serene decks to immerse yourself in the tranquil atmosphere. The main level offers two generous bedrooms, a sleek kitchen, and a convenient bathroom, enhancing the ease of entertaining. Ascend to the upper level, where a primary suite awaits, complete with contemporary amenities and a loft providing captivating views of the space below. The versatile lower level boasts space for relaxation or entertainment, highlighted by a second fireplace to keep the ambiance warm. Step out to the concrete patio, where a rejuvenating spa invites you to unwind and soak in the mountain air throughout the year. The fenced backyard provides a secure area for pets to frolic freely. Modern conveniences include a newly installed HVAC system with air conditioning, ensuring year-round comfort. With excellent rental potential and lake rights, this home exemplifies the pinnacle of mountain living.

results.remarks: Experience the timeless charm of this beautifully restored vintage cabin, perfectly positioned to capture breathtaking views of Lake Arrowhead, the Pinnacles, and the Deep Creek wilderness beyond. From nearly every room, you'll enjoy sweeping panoramas that bring the outdoors in-- Blending classic Old Arrowhead character with thoughtful modern updates, this inviting retreat offers the perfect mix of nostalgia and comfort. The home features two cozy bedrooms plus a versatile loft, currently used as the third bedroom space. Inside, original wood floors, a striking split-granite fireplace, and a handcrafted spiral staircase create a warm, one-of-a-kind atmosphere. Dual-pane windows and updated bathrooms add modern convenience while preserving the cabin's authentic mountain feel. Step outside to relax on either of two outdoor living spaces--a spacious deck on the main level and a lower patio--both offering spectacular lake and mountain views. Whether you're watching the sun rise over the lake, the snow fall on the peaks, or the oaks turn golden in autumn, this home provides a year-round backdrop of natural beauty. Located just up the street from the trail to Emerald Bay, the property offers easy access to nature while remaining only a short drive from Lake Arrowhead Village with its dining, shopping, and recreation. Coveted lake rights are included, completing this true mountain retreat. Sold furnished and ready to enjoy, this cabin is ideal as a serene escape, an artist's or writer's retreat, or a charming gathering place for family and friends. With  expansive views It's a rare opportunity to own the full Lake Arrowhead experience.

results.remarks:
Welcome to your dream mountain retreat in the heart of Lake Arrowhead with lake rights! Nestled on a spacious 10,360 sq. ft. lot, this beautiful 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers approximately 2,552 sq. ft. of inviting living space designed for both everyday comfort and unforgettable gatherings.
One of the home's most desirable features is its rare level-entry access, making year-round living easy and convenient. Step inside to a welcoming foyer that opens to warm, light-filled interiors featuring luxury vinyl plank flooring, plush carpeting, and tasteful updates throughout.
The remodeled kitchen is the heart of the home, showcasing granite countertops, double ovens, abundant cabinetry, and generous prep space—perfect for hosting family holidays, weekend getaways, or entertaining friends after a day on the lake.  Take in the fresh mountain air from the expansive covered Trex deck, where beautiful mountain views create the perfect backdrop for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or relaxing evenings surrounded by nature. The home's exterior has also been enhanced with newer Allura fiber cement siding for lasting beauty and durability.  Additional upgrades include dual-pane windows throughout most of the home, owned solar panels to help reduce energy costs, generous off-street parking, and rare RV parking—a highly sought-after feature in Lake Arrowhead.  Ideally located within walking distance to Lake Arrowhead Elementary School and the popular Tavern Bay beach and lake area, you'll enjoy convenient access to swimming, kayaking, hiking, and all the recreation that makes mountain living so special.
Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, a weekend mountain getaway, or a vacation rental investment, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect combination of comfort, location, and lifestyle in one of Lake Arrowhead's most desirable neighborhoods.
Some rooms have been virtually staged to illustrate the home's potential.

results.remarks: Time to escape to this beautifully updated lake view retreat!  Perfectly situated on a private road, surrounded by forest, & with the most amazing ridgeline & lake views, sits this completely renovated home. On the main level you will enter into a spacious living area complete with a real masonry  fireplace & wood burning stove insert.  That will keep the whole house warm all winter long! From the living area you will see the spacious dining area & slider out to the oversized rear deck.  Just adjacent is the all new kitchen with loads of cupboard space, open shelving, recessed lighting & large pantry. Just around the corner is a nice sized space you could use as a den, formal dining, office or?? The laundry is also conveniently located in its own closet just off this room. Once upstairs you will find 3 spacious bedrooms with lots of natural light & great views & a full bath in the hallway.  There is also a very large primary suite with its own bathroom.  The lowest level is your oversized 2 car garage along with 2 workshop/storage areas for all your extras.  Not a detail has been overlooked from the wide plank oak flooring to the beautifully remodeled kitchen with granite countertops & stainless appliances.  All new paint inside & out, new windows throughout, new redwood deck & railings, all new fixtures, recessed lighting, & 2 water heaters!  Upstairs has a tankless unit & downstairs is a full 50 gallon electric water heater.  You will never run out of hot water!  This is an all electric house for the utmost in efficiency.  New AC & heat pump too! Plumbing was redone all the way to the main line, new electrical panel, & the roof is less than 10 years old. This home is move in ready!  Four season living at it's finest.  And yes, Lake Rights Included!!!
